description: Lock cases for hammer-texture-scale-uv-locks. The +Z quad is 4 wide (U) by 2 tall (V), corners (0,0,0),(4,0,0),(4,2,0),(0,2,0), normal +Z, UV offset (0,0), scale (0.5,0.25), rotation 0, lightmap 16, smoothing 0, locks 1 (ScaleLock). The texturelock test group loads this file and checks it against the in-code cases; the check SKIPs (does not fail) when the file is not found under the repo root. Lock semantics (ticket, not Valve): a lock means the UV is glued to the FACE. ScaleLock keeps the texture's world size across a resize (UV range across the face unchanged). UvLock keeps each corner's UV across an edit — exact in the world-space MapUvMapping model, a bounded approximation in the FaceUv model for a shear (face-centre UV exact, corner residual under maxResidual).
name: hammer-texture-scale-uv-locks

uvLockShear.note: Top edge sheared +1 in U. The FaceUv form (offset + per-axis scale + rotation) cannot represent a shear exactly; the fit is the closest representable map (measured residual 0.6805, bound 0.75) and the face-centre UV is exact. The world-space MapUvMapping ApplyUvLock is exact for this shear (residual 0).
